corrections.before: Resolve primary first then all other Company regions with unrest, Bombay/Madras/Bengal Army order; each Commander orders own regions. Primary normal invasion/rebellion strength + local unrest, secondary unrest only. Exhaust newly active Army strength equal attack or as much as possible; insufficient means Region Loss. Successful defense clears unrest and Commander gains trophy. Vacant Commander replaced by Military Affairs then Chairman, acting substitute gains/loses no trophies. Additionally, if the primary Crisis was a normal Invasion which failed against the Company, remove one tower level from the attacker if possible.
corrections.after: Resolve primary attack first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company-controlled region with unrest, Bombay/Madras/Bengal Army order with each Commander choosing order in its Presidency. A normal primary Crisis uses ordinary Invasion/Rebellion attack strength plus target unrest; other regions attack with only local unrest. Use the printed Mounting Defense procedure: exhaust active Army pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible. The book says the Crisis succeeds when newly exhausted pieces do not equal that strength. A matched defense removes all target unrest and gives the Commander one trophy; if a normal primary Invasion failed, also remove one attacker tower if possible. Vacant Commander: Military Affairs acts, then Chairman if vacant, and acting player gains/loses no trophies. The source does not settle how an indivisible strength-2 alliance counts against a strength-1 attack; that concrete survival branch remains unresolved, not a verified >= ruling.
corrections.reason: Genuine source sufficiency correction: older insufficient/sufficient shorthand could imply an unverified >= ruling. Restore exact printed test and disclose unresolved alliance excess. This makes no passing claim and does not remove the hard question.
